conditions.name: Count incurred work and completion separately
conditions.context: A cancelled or deferred service, no-show, failed proposal or partial delivery can consume labour without producing a completed unit.
conditions.programme_implication: Retain actual preparation/handling as an exception or supported allocation. A zero delivered count must not erase incurred work; no completed-unit denominator exists when none were delivered.

conditions.name: Confirm audience fit and actual people-time
conditions.context: Shared sessions require compatible questions, permitted participants, confidentiality and a capable available owner.
conditions.programme_implication: Count one actual session where suitable, separate incompatible sessions where necessary, and all genuine presenter/reviewer person-time. Do not multiply the whole task by every nominal role.

conditions.name: Identify the shared asset and recipient handling
conditions.context: Reuse depends on the exact asset/version, task and necessary new work. A run may have shared and recipient-specific work.
conditions.programme_implication: Credit only the saved task once; retain actual routing, permissions, exception handling and genuinely distinct follow-through. Free/bundled access and effort remain separate.

conditions.name: Match the commercial task and current evidence
conditions.context: Guides, salary interpretation, search analytics and payroll investment research support different decisions. Edition labels and underlying evidence periods differ.
conditions.programme_implication: Test whether the proposed paid use adds value to existing public/bundled alternatives. Match task/country/evidence before scoping. Public offers are not achieved demand or labour quotes.

conditions.name: Carry remaining obligations over the actual term
conditions.context: Order, invoice, cash receipt, delivery, support and end of new sales are different states and dates.
conditions.programme_implication: Record scoped benefit periods and work still owed, including after a campaign closes. A short period cost is not the cost of an entire promise. Renewal remains unassumed.

conditions.name: Select a capable delivery route before a resource rate
conditions.context: Research and editorial coordination proxies do not establish commercial pay, financial/rights expertise, supplier availability or additional cash.
conditions.programme_implication: Keep the commercial rate unknown. Reconcile quoted packages, actual tasks and retained work once; include non-labour costs separately before pricing or a full programme conclusion.
